dogecoin.text: John McAfee has been charged with securities fraud over a “pump and dump” cryptocurrency scheme. Federal prosecutors unsealed a case against McAfee earned nearly $2 million by urging Twitter followers to invest in cryptocurrencies like Reddcoin and Dogecoin. Surprised?
Creator of Dogecoin reemerges. Definitely has an opinion about crypto and its current state of affairs. No dog in this battle, just an interested sideline spectator.

Turkish crypto exchange Thodex led with $2 billion in client funds. This was followed by dogecoin-inspired AnubisDAO at $58M, and Binance Smart Chain-based exchange Uranium Finance at $50M.
